fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Assistant Town Planner ATP Mains Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the mains exam city details for the recruitment of Assistant Town Planner posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 08 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Assistant Town Planner Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 03 November 2025, to 03 December 2025. The online examination is going to be conducted on 06 October 2026. Candidates who qualified for this pre examination can download their UPPSC Assistant Town Planner Mains Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 November 2025
  • Last Date : 03 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 December 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 10 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 07 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 29 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 9 July 2026
  • Result Available : 9 September 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 06 October 2026
  • Mains Exam City Details : 28 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST, ESM Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs.25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
